bienvenue.soustitre: Personal, portable and offline API key manager
bienvenue.presentation_1: ApiVault-3 keeps your API keys (OpenRouter, OpenAI, Mistral, and so on) together with their addresses, in a single file
bienvenue.av1c: are encrypted with AES-256-GCM using your master password.
bienvenue.av2c: stay in plain text: they are not secrets.
bienvenue.av3c: : nothing ever leaves the application folder.
bienvenue.av4: The whole folder can be copied to a USB stick and used as is.

creation.intro_3: stored: it is only used to derive the encryption key (PBKDF2-SHA256, 100,000 iterations).

parametres.mode_strict_1: The master password is asked every time the application starts. Nothing is stored in
parametres.mode_strict_2: apart from the derivation proof (salt + verify hash): stealing the file is not enough to read the keys.
parametres.mode_confort_1: The key derived from the password is remembered in
parametres.mode_confort_2: : the application opens directly on the next sessions. More convenient, but anyone who gets the file can read the keys without knowing the password.
parametres.mode_avertissement: Mode B: the unlock secret will be stored in vault.json. If you lose this file, your keys are compromised.
parametres.mdp_aide: A new salt and a new derivation proof are generated, and the vault master key is re-encrypted with the new password.
parametres.presse_case: Automatically clear the clipboard after 30 seconds (recommended)
parametres.presse_aide: After every copy of a key or a URL, the clipboard is emptied after 30 seconds to limit leaks. A copy made in another program in the meantime is never cleared.
parametres.langue_aide: The choice is saved in vault.json and applied on the next launch.
parametres.recuperation_active: Phrase recovery is enabled on this vault. The phrase lets you open your keys again if you forget your password.
parametres.recuperation_inactive: Phrase recovery is not enabled on this vault. Only the master password can open it.
parametres.recuperation_aide: A 24-word phrase is generated and only an encrypted copy of the vault master key is written to vault.json. Neither the phrase nor anything derived from it is stored.
parametres.export_aide_2: folder sits next to the application.
parametres.export_avertissement: The HTML and JSON exports contain your keys in plain text: they are as sensitive as the vault itself. Delete them as soon as possible.
parametres.import_aide_1: Importing replaces the current content of the vault. Accepted formats:
parametres.emplacements_aide: Everything is stored in the application folder (portable mode).
fournisseur.cle_valeur_conservee: Leave empty to keep the current value
modale.suppr_fournisseur_avertissement: This cannot be undone and the keys will not be recoverable.
modale.import_fichier_avertissement: The current content of the vault will be replaced.
modale.sauvegarde_corps: This backup is encrypted. Enter the master password that was used when it was created.
modale.import_vault_corps: This document contains encrypted keys. Enter its master password to import it.
modale.proteger_corps: This file is in plain text. Choose a master password (12 characters minimum) to encrypt the keys that will be imported.
modale.confort_corps: The key derived from your password will be stored in vault.json.
modale.activation_corps: Enter your master password: it is used to re-encrypt the vault master key (the API keys themselves are not changed). A 24-word phrase will then be generated.
modale.regenerer_corps: A recovery phrase already exists. Generating a new one makes the old phrase permanently unusable.
modale.export_clair_corps: This file will contain all your API keys in plain text, without encryption.
modale.export_clair_avertissement: Never share it, keep it offline and delete it right after use.
